title: Baobab EngineRelease (ADR-BCP-025)
description:
Definition library for EngineRelease, the Control Plane's immutable record of one version of one engine, its content-addressed artifacts, its per-provider contract support, and the desired release of an engine instance (ADR-BCP-025 sections 2.1-2.5, gate ER-01).
Validate resources against fragment URIs (e.g. #/$defs/EngineRelease), not the document root.

Invariants the Control Plane enforces beyond these shapes:
  A release's engine_id, release_version, artifacts, provider_support, capability_provider_declaration_digest and source_revision never change; only status moves, with an audited reason (section 2.1 rule 1).
  Recording an existing (engine_id, release_version) is accepted only as a byte-identical replay; different content is RELEASE_VERSION_CONFLICT (rule 2).
  An artifact digest belongs to at most one release of one engine (rule 3).
  Every provider_key belongs to the release's engine, every capability_key is catalogued, and provider_support equals the IMPLEMENTED support of the declaration the digest names (sections 2.1.2-2.1.3).
  Only an APPROVED release may become an instance's desired release, and a desired-state read never returns a release that is not APPROVED or DEPRECATED (sections 2.4-2.5).

Control Plane is the runtime authority. Shared is the contract authority.

Artifact.description: One artifact of a release, identified by its content digest (section 2.2). A reference with a tag and no digest is refused (RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIGEST_REQUIRED).

Provenance.description: A reference to a build provenance attestation, for example an in-toto or SLSA provenance statement (section 2.3). The Control Plane records and exposes it; it never verifies signatures itself.

attestation_uri.description: Where the attestation can be fetched. Carries no credential.

attestation_digest.description: Content digest of the attestation document.

builder_id.description: The builder identity the attestation names, e.g. a reusable workflow URI.

ProviderSupport.description: One capability one provider in the release implements, and the contract majors it supports (section 2.1.2, amendment A1). Only IMPLEMENTED declared support is recorded; PARTIAL and planned capabilities never are.

provider_key.description: <engine-id>.<provider-name>. Its engine segment must equal the release's engine_id.

capability_key.description: Must be a capability in Shared's catalogue.

EngineReleaseRecordRequest.description: What a caller submits to record a release. The Control Plane mints release_id, sets status CANDIDATE, and takes recorded_by from the authenticated principal; none of them is accepted here.

provider_support.description: Empty only when the declaration at source_revision declares no IMPLEMENTED support.

EngineRelease.description: An immutable release of one engine (section 2.1).

EngineReleaseStatusChangeRequest.description: Deprecate or revoke a release along release-policy.yaml status_transitions. Approval is not a status change request: it is the control-plane/v1 ENGINE_RELEASE_APPROVAL changeset, the only path from CANDIDATE to APPROVED (ADR-BCP-021, section 2.4). Revocation must say what happens to every instance whose desired release is the revoked one: each is given an APPROVED replacement of the same engine or has its desired release cleared, in the same transaction; revocation is refused while any such instance is uncovered (RELEASE_REVOCATION_UNCOVERED, section 2.4).

desiredReleaseDisposition.description: What a revocation does to one instance that desires the revoked release.

EngineInstanceDesiredRelease.description: The release an engine instance is desired to run (section 2.5), as infrastructure tooling reads it. It changes only through a controlled change (ADR-BCP-021). desired_release_id is null when none is desired. The Control Plane never deploys anything: tooling reads this and executes it.

desired_release.description: The desired release itself, present whenever desired_release_id is set. Its status is always APPROVED or DEPRECATED: a read never returns a desired release in any other status.

changeset_id.description: The controlled change that set the current desired release.

version.description: Increments on every change of desired release; a stale writer is refused.

auditReason.description: Why the change was made, for the audit trail. Never a secret or personal data.
